title: The complete Modal2D documentation and interactive companions
introduction: Ten project-owned documents cover workflows, mathematical models, implementation, interactive teaching examples and design history. Their original layouts and source downloads are preserved. The brochure integrates all eighteen teaching labs by topic; historical plans remain labeled as source context.
